name: Prague Castle
description: Prague Castle is a castle complex in Prague, Czech Republic. Opening hours: 06:00 - 22:00 daily (complex), historical buildings 09:00 - 17:00. Admission: 450 CZK (approx €18).

name: Charles Bridge
description: Historic bridge that crosses the Vltava river. Always open. Free admission.

name: Prague Astronomical Clock
description: Medieval astronomical clock attached to the Old Town Hall. Shows every hour. Admission to tower: 300 CZK (approx €12). Open 11:00-19:00 Monday, 09:00-19:00 Tue-Sun.
